Spartanburg, South Carolina · stay

Hotels in Spartanburg for cyclists

Places to stay in Spartanburg when you are in town to ride. Picked for being near the start, easy with a bike, or cheap. Book early for event weekends. Rooms go first.

For: The Assault on Mt. Mitchell.

Hotels in Spartanburg for cyclists, listed

  1. Spartanburg Marriott

    $$$ · 299 North Church Street, Spartanburg, SC 29306

    0.2 miles from the Memorial Auditorium start; the obvious pick for the Assaults.

  2. AC Hotel by Marriott Spartanburg

    $$$ · 225 West Main Street, Spartanburg, SC 29306

    Downtown on Main Street, about 0.6 miles from the auditorium and steps from Morgan Square restaurants.

  3. Fairfield Inn & Suites Spartanburg Downtown

    $$ · Downtown Spartanburg, SC

    Newer mid-price chain downtown; listed by the visitor bureau as the downtown option.

  4. Hampton Inn & Suites Spartanburg I-26

    $$ · 801 Spartan Blvd, Spartanburg, SC 29301

    Budget-friendlier chain off I-26 exit 21, about 3.7 miles from the start; drive in.

  5. Holiday Inn Express & Suites Spartanburg I-26

    $$ · 895 Spartan Blvd, Spartanburg, SC 29301

    Same I-26 cluster, about 3.5 miles from the auditorium.
